io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription:
SECONDED is the oracle for agents. Before your agent acts, it checks the real cost, the real contract and the real risk, read live and confirmed by two rival AIs, one from OpenAI and one from Anthropic. Every answer comes with a signed receipt. Standard checks charge only after agreement and a saved answer; a disagreement is signed and free. Degen Check costs $0.10 for a saved signed answer, including a signed models_disagree answer.

13 available checks: Trade Check ($0.25 small, $1.50 medium); Stock Token Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Token Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Agent Registry Check ($0.25 small); Address Screening Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Cross-Chain Compare ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Scam Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small, $1.50 medium, $2.50 large); Lending Check ($0.25 small); Agent Work Payout Check ($0.25 small); x402 Payment Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Shielded Route Check ($0.25 small); Bridge Route Check ($0.10 ($0.15 on Robinhood) small); Degen Check ($0.10 small). Payment networks: Base USDC (eip155:8453); Arc USDC (eip155:5042); Robinhood Chain USDG (eip155:4663). Base mainnet is the default; other networks require explicit selection. Payments use POST /v1/x402/checks; /v1/checks is operator rollback only until all three mainnet canaries pass. New wallets: $2.50 per check, $25/day. Chat may only tighten or freeze; raising limits, unfreezing and switching wallets require the owner terminal. Touch ID or an installed administrator key adds independent owner approval. Without either, six-character TTY confirmation does not stop agents with shell access. Legacy nil or above-$25/day policies freeze pending owner review. Automatic private-file fallback is UNENCRYPTED; fund a dedicated wallet with only a few dollars. Native binaries have no Apple notarization or Windows Authenticode; verify the SSH-signed SHA-256 manifest. Availability is a bundled offline snapshot, not a live probe; a quote checks current availability. The 13 products use 12 check tools and nine utilities: Asset Check selects token or stock_token. seconded_quote accepts base, arc, robinhood and their supported testnet selectors as its payment network.
